output.body: This process of self-calling repeats until it hits a base case, which is a simple scenario it can solve directly without making another call. Every recursive function needs a base case to act as a stopping point, otherwise it would call itself forever.
output.key_idea: A recursive function solves a problem by calling itself on smaller versions of the same problem.
output.question: To get started, can you think of a real-world task that follows a similar pattern of repeating steps with a clear end?
